provenance.title: Launch HN: Kampala (YC W26) – Reverse-Engineer Apps into APIs

facts.statement: Alex is a co-founder of Kampala.
Tarun is a co-founder of Kampala.

Kampala is a man-in-the-middle (MITM) style proxy that allows you to agentically reverse engineer existing workflows without brittle browser automation or computer use agents and works for websites, mobile apps, and desktop apps.
facts.value: Reverse-Engineer Apps into APIs via a MITM style proxy for websites, mobile and desktop apps

facts.statement: Kampala functions as a man-in-the-middle (MITM) proxy.
Kampala automates interactions deterministically in seconds using existing session tokens and anti-bot cookies.
facts.value: automate interactions deterministically using session tokens and anti-bot cookies

facts.statement: Kampala is used to reverse-engineer existing workflows into APIs without brittle browser automation or computer use agents.
facts.value: reverse-engineer workflows into APIs without browser automation

facts.statement: Kampala was publicly launched approximately in April 2026 as part of Y Combinator W26 batch.

Since March 1, 2026, Zatanna has modeled a total of 4,829,385,502 requests processed based on an average of 1.22 million requests per hour.
Zatanna maps human-only software workflows and exposes them as reliable APIs your AI agents and internal tools can call in production, without browser automation scripts to maintain.
facts.value: Turn software workflows into reliable APIs for AI agents without browser automation

facts.statement: Zatanna works at the network layer to reverse-engineer the underlying API calls behind any portal and deploy them as direct endpoints, offering milliseconds latency instead of seconds, with structured data and stable integrations.
facts.value: network layer reverse-engineering of API calls for stable API integration

facts.statement: Zatanna depends on observing actual network traffic behind portal workflows and reconstructing the exact request flow including auth, sessions, and sequencing.
facts.value: network traffic observation and reconstruction of request flow

facts.statement: Zatanna provides a single stable endpoint API that manages authentication, retries, anti-bot detection and session handling underneath.
facts.value: single stable API endpoint managing auth and retries

facts.statement: Zatanna is designed to enable AI agents to call APIs that perform real work in third-party software portals, even ones without public APIs.
facts.value: enable AI agents to perform work in third-party portals without public APIs

facts.statement: To start using Zatanna, users can book a 30-minute workflow review where the workflow is walked through once and an endpoint deployed; most integrations go live within days.
facts.value: book a 30-minute workflow review before integration

what_would_change_my_mind.text: Disqualifier D-1: find a stated prior role for somebody they name, something one of them is stated to have built, or a public repository. It would then no longer hold, and the call would no longer be forced to Pass.
Disqualifier D-4: find a self-serve path, a published price, an open-source licence, or a public repository. It would then no longer hold, and the call would no longer be forced to Pass.
D1 Founder–market fit & technical depth: find a prior employer, role or period stated for somebody the company names. That moves it from 6–12 to 13–19 (+7).
